# POST /check Endpoint Implementation

## Overview
The POST `/check` endpoint has been implemented in `app.js` according to the reference implementation in `docs/RULES_ENGINE.md`. The endpoint evaluates a caller-supplied rule expression against a request context.

```json
{

}
```

```json
  "result": true,
  "rule": "ctx.amount > 100",

}
```

- Failed to evaluate: `{"error": "Failed to evaluate rule", "message": "error details"}`
